displayName.zh-CN: NeMo FastConformer 西班牙语 (int8)

summary.en: Offline Spanish recognizer from NVIDIA (the transducer head of stt_es_fastconformer_hybrid_large_pc) with punctuation and capitalization; it recognizes each sentence after a pause. Trained on Common Voice, MLS, VoxPopuli and Fisher Spanish.
summary.zh-CN: NVIDIA 的离线西班牙语识别模型 (stt_es_fastconformer_hybrid_large_pc 的 transducer 头), 自带标点与大小写, 每说完一句识别一次. 训练数据为 Common Voice, MLS, VoxPopuli 与 Fisher Spanish.

displayName.zh-CN: SenseVoice Small 多语言 (int8)

summary.en: Offline recognizer for Mandarin, Cantonese, English, Japanese and Korean with punctuation, run on segments cut by voice activity detection. Official FunAudioLLM SenseVoiceSmall export; commercial use is permitted with attribution.
summary.zh-CN: 离线识别普通话, 粤语, 英语, 日语与韩语, 输出带标点, 配合语音活动检测切段使用. FunAudioLLM 官方 SenseVoiceSmall 导出, 注明出处后可商用.

displayName.zh-CN: 流式 Zipformer 八语 (PengChengStarling, int8)

summary.en: Streaming recognizer for Arabic, English, Indonesian, Japanese, Russian, Thai, Vietnamese and Chinese that detects the language by itself and writes no punctuation. The weights are Apache-2.0, but the training data is not named, so whether commercial use is allowed is unknown.
summary.zh-CN: 阿拉伯语, 英语, 印尼语, 日语, 俄语, 泰语, 越南语与中文的流式识别模型, 自动判别语言, 不出标点. 权重为 Apache-2.0, 但训练数据未点名, 能否商用未知.

displayName.zh-CN: 流式 Zipformer 英文 (int8, 移动版)

summary.en: Lightweight streaming recognizer for English trained on LibriSpeech. Hotwords are unavailable because the archive has no BPE vocabulary.
summary.zh-CN: 基于 LibriSpeech 训练的轻量英语流式识别模型. 归档不含 BPE 词表, 因此不支持热词.

displayName.zh-CN: 流式 Zipformer 法语 (int8)

summary.en: Streaming recognizer for French trained on Common Voice 12 (CC0). Hotwords are unavailable because the archive has no BPE vocabulary.
summary.zh-CN: 基于 Common Voice 12 (CC0) 训练的法语流式识别模型. 归档不含 BPE 词表, 因此不支持热词.

displayName.zh-CN: 流式 Zipformer 韩语 (int8)

summary.en: Streaming recognizer for Korean trained on KsponSpeech from AI Hub, whose terms restrict use outside Korea. Installed directly from the sherpa-onnx release, without a mirror.
summary.zh-CN: 基于 AI Hub 的 KsponSpeech 训练的韩语流式识别模型, 该数据的条款限制韩国境外使用. 直接从 sherpa-onnx 发布安装, 没有镜像.

displayName.zh-CN: 流式 Zipformer 俄语 (int8, 小型)

summary.en: Small streaming recognizer for Russian from the Vosk project (alphacep). Hotwords are unavailable because the catalog installs no BPE vocabulary.
summary.zh-CN: Vosk 项目 (alphacep) 的小型俄语流式识别模型. 目录不安装 BPE 词表, 因此不支持热词.

displayName.zh-CN: 流式 Zipformer 中英双语 (int8)

summary.en: Default streaming recognizer for Mandarin, English and mixed speech, with endpoint detection and hotwords. int8 encoder and joiner, float32 decoder.
summary.zh-CN: 默认流式识别模型, 支持普通话, 英语及中英混说, 可用端点检测与热词. 编码器与联合网络为 int8, 解码器为 float32.

displayName.zh-CN: 流式 Zipformer 中文 (int8, 2025)

summary.en: Newer large streaming recognizer for Mandarin, trained on about 14,000 hours of public Chinese corpora, several of which allow non-commercial use only.
summary.zh-CN: 较新的大型普通话流式识别模型, 由约 14000 小时公开中文语料训练, 其中多个语料仅限非商业用途.

displayName.zh-CN: 唤醒词检测 中英文 (3M)

summary.en: Open-vocabulary keyword spotter with about 3 million parameters for Mandarin and English. Keywords become pinyin and phone tokens; about 320 ms chunk latency.
summary.zh-CN: 约 300 万参数的开放词表唤醒词模型, 支持普通话与英语. 关键词转换为拼音与音素 token, 分块延迟约 320 毫秒.

displayName.zh-CN: CNN-BiLSTM 标点与大小写 英文 (int8)

summary.en: Adds punctuation and restores capital letters in English text. Small and fast; from the Edge-Punct-Casing project.
summary.zh-CN: 为英文文本加标点并恢复大写字母. 体积小, 速度快; 来自 Edge-Punct-Casing 项目.

displayName.zh-CN: CT-Transformer 标点 中英文 (int8)

summary.en: Adds punctuation to recognized Chinese and English sentences, offline. Converted from the FunASR CT-Transformer model (Apache-2.0, FunASR attribution kept).
summary.zh-CN: 离线为识别出的中英文句子加标点. 由 FunASR 的 CT-Transformer 模型转换 (Apache-2.0, 保留 FunASR 署名).

displayName.zh-CN: Kokoro v1.0 多语言 (int8)

summary.en: Kokoro-82M v1.0, int8, 24 kHz output, with voices for American and British English, Chinese, Spanish, French, Hindi, Italian and Brazilian Portuguese. Its five Japanese voices are not offered: sherpa-onnx 1.13.8 cannot read Japanese text for Kokoro.
summary.zh-CN: Kokoro-82M v1.0, int8 量化, 输出 24 kHz, 含美式与英式英语, 中文, 西班牙语, 法语, 印地语, 意大利语与巴西葡萄牙语音色. 5 个日语音色不提供: sherpa-onnx 1.13.8 不能为 Kokoro 读日语文字.

displayName.zh-CN: Kokoro v1.1 中英文

summary.en: Kokoro-82M v1.1-zh with 103 voices (100 Chinese, 3 English), 24 kHz output. The largest download in this catalog.
summary.zh-CN: Kokoro-82M v1.1-zh, 含 103 个音色 (100 个中文, 3 个英文), 输出 24 kHz, 是本目录中体积最大的模型.

displayName.zh-CN: Matcha-TTS 标贝中文女声

summary.en: One female Mandarin voice trained with icefall on the Data-Baker corpus, with the HiFi-GAN v2 vocoder, 22.05 kHz output. The corpus allows non-commercial use only.
summary.zh-CN: 使用 icefall 在标贝语料上训练的普通话女声, 搭配 HiFi-GAN v2 声码器, 输出 22.05 kHz. 该语料仅限非商业用途.

displayName.zh-CN: VITS AISHELL-3 中文, 174 个音色

summary.en: Small multi-speaker Mandarin model trained with icefall on AISHELL-3, 8 kHz output. The optional 181 MB rule.far normalizer is omitted.
summary.zh-CN: 使用 icefall 在 AISHELL-3 上训练的小型多说话人普通话模型, 输出 8 kHz. 省略了可选的 181 MB 文本规范化规则 rule.far.

displayName.zh-CN: MeloTTS 中英混读 (VITS)

summary.en: One female voice from MyShell.ai MeloTTS that reads Mandarin mixed with English, 44.1 kHz output.
summary.zh-CN: MyShell.ai MeloTTS 的单一女声, 可朗读夹杂英文的普通话, 输出 44.1 kHz.

displayName.zh-CN: Mimic 3 韩语 KSS (低质量)

summary.en: One female Korean voice from Mycroft Mimic 3, 22.05 kHz output, low quality. The weights are CC0, but its KSS training data is licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, so it may only be used for non-commercial purposes.
summary.zh-CN: Mycroft Mimic 3 的韩语女声, 输出 22.05 kHz, 低质量档. 权重为 CC0, 但 KSS 训练数据为 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 许可, 仅限非商业用途.

displayName.zh-CN: Piper 阿拉伯语 SA dii (高质量, int8)

summary.en: One female Arabic voice from OpenVoiceOS (phoonnx), int8, 22.05 kHz output. Trained on synthetic speech licensed CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, so it may only be used for non-commercial purposes.
summary.zh-CN: OpenVoiceOS (phoonnx) 的阿拉伯语女声, int8 量化, 输出 22.05 kHz. 训练数据为 CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 许可的合成语音, 仅限非商业用途.

displayName.en: Piper ar_JO SA miro V2 (high, int8)
displayName.zh-CN: Piper 阿拉伯语 SA miro V2 (高质量, int8)

summary.en: One male Arabic voice from OpenVoiceOS (phoonnx), int8, 22.05 kHz output. The voice and its synthetic training speech are licensed CC BY-NC-ND 4.0: non-commercial use only, installed directly from the sherpa-onnx release without a mirror.
summary.zh-CN: OpenVoiceOS (phoonnx) 的阿拉伯语男声, int8 量化, 输出 22.05 kHz. 声音与其合成训练语音均为 CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 许可, 仅限非商业用途, 直接从 sherpa-onnx 发布安装, 没有镜像.

displayName.zh-CN: Piper 德语 thorsten (中等质量, int8)

summary.en: One German voice from the Piper project, int8, 22.05 kHz output. Fine-tuned from the Lessac voice, whose Blizzard 2013 training data is licensed for research use only.
summary.zh-CN: Piper 项目的德语单一音色, int8 量化, 输出 22.05 kHz. 由 Lessac 音色微调而来, 其 Blizzard 2013 训练数据仅许可用于研究.

displayName.zh-CN: Piper 美式英语 lessac (中等质量)

summary.en: One US English voice from the Piper project, 22.05 kHz output. Trained on Lessac Blizzard 2013 data, licensed for research use only.
summary.zh-CN: Piper 项目的美式英语单一音色, 输出 22.05 kHz. 训练数据 Lessac Blizzard 2013 仅许可用于研究.

displayName.zh-CN: Piper 西班牙语 davefx (中等质量, int8)

summary.en: One Spanish voice from the Piper project, int8, 22.05 kHz output. Fine-tuned from the Lessac voice, whose Blizzard 2013 training data is licensed for research use only.
summary.zh-CN: Piper 项目的西班牙语单一音色, int8 量化, 输出 22.05 kHz. 由 Lessac 音色微调而来, 其 Blizzard 2013 训练数据仅许可用于研究.

displayName.zh-CN: Piper 法语 siwis (中等质量, int8)

summary.en: One French voice from the Piper project, int8, 22.05 kHz output. Fine-tuned from the Lessac voice, whose Blizzard 2013 training data is licensed for research use only.
summary.zh-CN: Piper 项目的法语单一音色, int8 量化, 输出 22.05 kHz. 由 Lessac 音色微调而来, 其 Blizzard 2013 训练数据仅许可用于研究.

displayName.zh-CN: Piper 俄语 denis (中等质量, int8)

summary.en: One Russian voice from the Piper project, int8, 22.05 kHz output. Fine-tuned from the Lessac voice, whose Blizzard 2013 training data is licensed for research use only.
summary.zh-CN: Piper 项目的俄语单一音色, int8 量化, 输出 22.05 kHz. 由 Lessac 音色微调而来, 其 Blizzard 2013 训练数据仅许可用于研究.
